jobs.description: Apply NowProduct Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Cyber Defense OperationsDate: 10/08/2026Company: SAPWe help the world run betterAt SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.Summary & Role Information:Join SAP Cloud Infrastructure and help build the next generation of cloud services and platform capabilities powering SAP's sovereign and regulated cloud environments.As a Product Security Senior Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our Cyber Defense capability — coordinating and steering our external managed SOC partner, integrating security tooling into our cloud operations stack, and ensuring consistent detection, response, and monitoring across 30+ regional datacenters globally, from Australia to Toronto. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.What You'll Do:- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure tooling coverage keeps pace with platform expansion into new regions.- Coordinate incident response processes between the external SOC, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations. Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.What You Bring:Technical Foundation- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.Core AI Skills- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.Professional Skills- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.Tech You Bring- SIEM/SOAR platforms- Logging and monitoring tooling- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms- Kubernetes ecosystem- GitHub for configuration and issue management- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages- Cloud computing environments- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana- Threat intelligence platforms- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNowMeet the Team:You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We work on real infrastructure problems, share what we learn, and believe a private cloud is something you build, not something you rent.​Bring out your bestSAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.We win with inclusionSAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. jobs.occupation: Red Teamer/ Pentester Cybersecurity Audit  (m/f/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: **Start your cyber career with us!**As part of the globalCybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals byproviding objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens ManagingBoard and Audit Committee. As a business partner to Siemens executive management,we leverage our expertise in a wide range of topics to create an impact thatdrives change. We offer a vibrant and inclusive environment which ensures avariety of perspectives and enables big picture thinking.To deliver on ourvision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, weoffer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept oflifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset wherecontinuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. Weinvest in our expertise and therefore provide continuous career coaching,trainings and mentoring, all whilst working with top Siemens business leaderson multiple high-profile projects around the world.Our Cybersecurity teamprovides core assurance over the Cybersecurity health of the company whichincludes IT and OT infrastructures, product security, software development andcloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, aninternational mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and howCybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one ofthem?To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function FIN A click here (https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:832d2c5d-e30c-4163-a1be-9fa3d67f645b/controlling-and-finance-assurance-info-for-applicants.pdf)What part will you play?- As valuable member of the assurance teamyou will be responsible for conducting Cybersecurity assessments acrossthe entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems,factories, and software development centers. During this process you willperform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios forstate-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations totranslate technical findings into management information so that they cantake effective actions.- Apply hacking principles and red teammethodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviorsfaced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications,on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.- You work closely with cybersecurityexperts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tacklingthe root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modernchallenges.- You independently conduct research onlatest developments in Cybersecurity technologies and threats andunderstand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.What you need to make real what matters- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree)in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such asGIAC GPEN,  OSCP, CRTP, eJPT, CREST, etc. are a plus.- Good scripting and programming skills andexperience with languages such as Bash, Python,  Powershell, andC++ / C#.- 2+ years of professional full-time workingexperience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing /red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.- Demonstrated affinity to learn about thelatest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuouslychallenging environment.- You have first experience with one or moreof the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: applicationand software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation andscaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.- Demonstrated first experience in capturethe flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is aplus.- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day workis considered an advantage.- Fluent in English. German or otherlanguages are a plus.- You demonstrate an international mindsetand are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team.Whilecommitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretchbeyond our comfort zone. FIN A offers ample of opportunities to seek thechallenge:Caring forthe world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at FIN A for over adecade.Everyone at FIN A has the possibility to actively engage in our globalCSR community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motivedCSR projects.What we offer- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family - Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Pension plan to ensure financial security - 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growthAny questions left?Click here (https://siemens-my.sharepoint.com/personal/liuyan_siemens_com/Documents/DataBackup250210/D/Arbeit/CFA/CSA/JD/Cyber%20Process%20Auditor%20ERA12.docx)  if you wish to find out more about Siemens before applying.As an equal-opportunity employer weare happy to consider applications from individuals with disabilities (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/home/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/jobs-ohne-barrieren.html) .

jobs.occupation: Demand Capacity Planner (all genders) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Bei HelloFresh ist unsere Mission einfach: To change the way people, eat forever. Als globales, digital-natives FMCG-Unternehmen und weltweit führender Anbieter von Kochboxen gestalten wir die traditionelle Lebensmittel-Lieferkette neu - mit einem datengetriebenen On-Demand-Modell, das skalierbares Wachstum ermöglicht und Lebensmittel nachhaltiger liefert. Zur HelloFresh Group gehören acht Marken, darunter HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate und Chef Plate sowie Ready-to-eat Angebote von Factor und YouFoodz, Fleisch- und Meeeresfrüchte Abonnements von Good Chop und Tiernahrung von The Pets Table. Durch Technologie, Daten und kulinarische Innovation schaffen wir personalisierte Food-Erlebnisse für Millionen von Haushalten weltweit.The role:What's in the BoxAs a Strategic Demand Capacity Planner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the long-term alignment between European market demand and our global supplier, production, and logistics networks. Sitting within the Central Planning team and nested in the International Operations department, you will report directly to the Associate Director of Strategic Planning.Your mission is to bridge the gap between commercial ambition and operational reality.
